storage.name: T3 Code application data
storage.explanation: Settings, credentials, attachments, browser files, logs, and unknown state remain protected. Use T3 Code to manage them.

storage.name: T3 Code scratch projects
storage.explanation: Scratch projects can contain source files and dependencies. Moppo keeps the whole folder protected.

storage.name: T3 Code downloaded tools
storage.explanation: Installed tools can be required by T3 Code. Moppo keeps them protected.
